description: Script structure, retention patterns, pacing, and writing techniques

principles.rule: The Green/Purple Script Formula: alternate between curiosity-building sections (green) and payoff sections (purple)
principles.implication: Without a green section first, the purple section is just boring information instead of a satisfying answer.
principles.structure: Green → Purple → Green → Purple throughout the entire video

principles.rule: The Water Tank analogy: viewers start at full interest which drains quickly. Refill by consistently delivering value.
principles.implication: Spread key points evenly throughout. Never cluster all value at the beginning or end.

principles.rule: The But/Therefore structure beats And/Then structure
principles.bad_example: This happened AND then this happened AND then this happened
principles.good_example: We tried this, BUT that got in the way. THEREFORE, we had to do this, BUT it didn't work. SO, we tried this.
principles.implication: Creates seamless flow with no exit points. Applies to scenes, topics, AND individual sentences.

principles.rule: Explain as simply as possible — a 10-min video that could have been 3 minutes will be boring
principles.caveat: But trimming too far makes it chaotic and soulless. Find the sweet spot.
principles.implication: Every sentence must earn its place. If it doesn't add value, cut it.

principles.rule: Make it feel like a natural conversation, not a textbook
principles.implication: AI writes like books. Always rewrite AI output to sound conversational.

four_curiosity_methods.description: Four ways to create curiosity for green sections

methods.name: mystery
methods.description: Create a mystery or present a problem/question lacking an answer
methods.example: But there was one detail that didn't add up...

methods.name: counterintuitive
methods.example: The safest country in the world has the highest murder rate for one specific crime...

methods.name: secret
methods.description: Reveal that someone knows a secret
methods.example: The CIA knew exactly what happened, but they buried the evidence for 20 years...

methods.name: missing_piece
methods.description: Suggest there is a missing component or something important not yet considered
methods.example: But everyone was overlooking the most obvious clue...

valuable_fluff.description: Ryan Trahan technique: extend videos by ADDING value, not stretching content
methods: Add humor that reinforces the point
Add personal connections or relatable tangents
Add interesting side stories that enrich the main narrative
Add analogies that make abstract concepts vivid
valuable_fluff.anti_pattern: Never pad runtime by repeating the same point in different words

uncertainty_storytelling.description: Intrigue comes from uncertainty — the key to turning boring videos into captivating stories
litmus_test: Does the viewer know what is happening?
Do they know why it is important?
Do they know what could go wrong?
uncertainty_storytelling.rule: If you cannot create curiosity/expectations for a scene, cut it or summarize with a voiceover sentence

pockets_of_dopamine.description: Plan quick breaks throughout the video to prevent overwhelming the viewer
pockets_of_dopamine.placement: Spread evenly — prevents viewer fatigue during dense informational sections

energy_variation.description: Vary the energy level throughout — contrast between sections forces viewers back into focus
energy_variation.pattern: Hype-edited section → mellow A-roll → hype section → calm reflection
energy_variation.rule: Mood should fluctuate: excitement to worry to joy to unease

script_quality.description: Score every script against these criteria before production

criteria.name: green_purple_ratio
criteria.description: Does the script alternate between curiosity and payoff?
criteria.target: Every purple section preceded by a green section

criteria.name: water_tank_pacing
criteria.description: Are value moments spread evenly throughout?
criteria.target: No gap longer than 2-3 minutes without a refill

criteria.name: but_therefore_flow
criteria.description: Does the narrative use causal connections, not just sequential listing?

criteria.name: conversational_tone
criteria.description: Does it sound like a person talking, not a textbook?

criteria.name: trim_test
criteria.description: Could the video be significantly shorter without losing value?
criteria.target: Every paragraph earns its place. No repetition disguised as emphasis.

criteria.name: energy_variation
criteria.description: Does the energy level vary throughout?
criteria.target: At least 3-4 energy shifts across the video

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Would a first-time viewer with zero context understand everything?
criteria.target: No jargon without explanation, no assumed knowledge

anti_patterns.mistake: Dumping information without creating curiosity first
anti_patterns.consequence: Viewer has no reason to care about the answer
anti_patterns.fix: Always set up the question (green) before delivering the answer (purple)

anti_patterns.mistake: Using AI to write the full script
anti_patterns.consequence: AI writes like books, not like conversational YouTube. Sounds robotic.
anti_patterns.fix: Use AI for vocabulary, shortening sentences, and flow — but never the full script

anti_patterns.mistake: Asking for likes/subs in the intro
anti_patterns.consequence: Breaks immersion at the most critical retention moment
anti_patterns.fix: Never ask in intro. If at all, mid-video after delivering value.

anti_patterns.consequence: The second half drops off because viewers sense the ending
anti_patterns.fix: Keep the second half just as good. No wind-down, no 'thanks for watching'.

anti_patterns.consequence: Feels like a list, not a story. Viewers disengage.
anti_patterns.fix: Use but/therefore/so connections to create causal flow
